name: tinyllama-chat
description: A minimal chat panel for the local TinyLlama model served by src/inference_server.py. No GitHub Copilot needed.

tinyllama.serverUrl.description: Base URL of the local OpenAI-compatible server (python src/inference_server.py).

tinyllama.maxTokens.description: Maximum length of each reply, in tokens.

tinyllama.thinking.description: Let models that think before answering, such as Qwen, do so. Thinking counts toward tinyllama.maxTokens, and can use it all up before any answer. When off, the request includes "reasoning_effort": "none". TinyLlama ignores this setting.

tinyllama.model.description: Model name sent to the server. "tinyllama" for src/inference_server.py; for Ollama or Foundry Local, the name of a model you've downloaded there (see 05_readme-models.md).
